description: Search the whole KT2440 proteome for an OprI-like lipoprotein, the substrate whose peptidoglycan tether PP_1451 is proposed to hydrolyse

import requests, numpy as np, re, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- 1. get P. aeruginosa OprI (the characterised substrate of LdtPae2/PA2854) ----
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
   params=dict(query='gene:oprI AND organism_id:208964 AND reviewed:true',format="json",size=5,
               fields="accession,id,protein_name,length,sequence"),timeout=30).json()["results"]
for e in r: print("PAO1 OprI:",e["primaryAccession"],e["uniProtkbId"],e["sequence"]["length"])
OPRI=r[0]["sequence"]["value"]; OPRI_ACC=r[0]["primaryAccession"]
print("OprI seq:",OPRI)
print("OprI residue 83 =",OPRI[82], " (PMID 42100858: epsilon-amino group of Lys83 of OprI is attached to the stem peptide)")

# ---- 2. KT2440 proteome, find OprI-like lipoproteins ----
fa=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
   params=dict(query='proteome:UP000000556',format="fasta"),timeout=120).text
heads=[];seqs=[]
for blk in fa.split("\n>"):
    L=blk.lstrip(">").split("\n"); heads.append(L[0]); seqs.append("".join(L[1:]))
print("KT2440 proteins:",len(heads))

AAS="ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYVBZXU*O"
idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAS)}
_b="""4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
-1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
-1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
Bm=np.full((26,26),-4,dtype=np.int16)
rr=[x.split() for x in _b.split("\n")]
for i in range(20):
    for j in range(20): Bm[i,j]=int(rr[i][j])

db=np.concatenate([np.array([idx.get(c,22) for c in s],dtype=np.int8) for s in seqs])
own=np.concatenate([np.full(len(s),i,dtype=np.int32) for i,s in enumerate(seqs)])
def msp(query):
    H=np.zeros(len(db),dtype=np.int32); best=np.zeros(len(db),dtype=np.int32)
    for c in query:
        s=Bm[idx.get(c,22)][db].astype(np.int32)
        Hs=np.empty_like(H); Hs[0]=0; Hs[1:]=H[:-1]
        H=np.maximum(0,Hs+s); np.maximum(best,H,out=best)
    out=np.zeros(len(heads),dtype=np.int32); np.maximum.at(out,own,best); return out
sc=msp(OPRI)
order=np.argsort(-sc)[:8]
print("\n=== KT2440 proteins most similar to P. aeruginosa OprI (ungapped MSP, BLOSUM62) ===")
for i in order:
    h=heads[i]; acc=h.split("|")[1]
    gn=re.search(r"GN=(\S+)",h); gn=gn.group(1) if gn else "-"
    print(f"  score {sc[i]:4d}  {acc:8s} {gn:12s} len {len(seqs[i]):4d}  {h.split('OS=')[0].split(' ',1)[1][:58]}")
top=int(order[0]); CAND=seqs[top]; CACC=heads[top].split("|")[1]
print("\nTop candidate sequence:",CACC,len(CAND),"aa")
print(CAND)
plt.figure(figsize=(8,4))
plt.hist(sc,bins=60,color="#9aa0a6")
plt.axvline(sc[top],color="#b3261e")
plt.text(sc[top]-2,plt.ylim()[1]*0.5,f"{CACC}\nscore {sc[top]}",ha="right",fontsize=9,color="#b3261e")
plt.yscale("log"); plt.xlabel("ungapped MSP score against P. aeruginosa OprI")
plt.ylabel("KT2440 proteins (log)")
plt.title("Search of all 5,527 KT2440 proteins for an OprI-like lipoprotein")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
